meta.name: optimizing-query-text
meta.description:
Optimizes Snowflake SQL query performance from provided query text. Use when optimizing Snowflake SQL for:
(1) User provides or pastes a SQL query and asks to optimize, tune, or improve it
(2) Task mentions "slow query", "make faster", "improve performance", "optimize SQL", or "query tuning"
(3) Reviewing SQL for performance anti-patterns (function on filter column, implicit joins, etc.)
(4) User asks why a query is slow or how to speed it up

copy.tagline: 优化 Snowflake SQL 查询性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到 Snowflake 查询慢的问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face slow Snowflake queries

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当你提供一段 Snowflake SQL 查询文本，Claude 会分析并返回优化后的 SQL，同时确保结果与原查询完全相同。
howto.when: 当你粘贴 SQL 查询并要求优化、调优或改进，或者提到“慢查询”、“提速”、“优化 SQL”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化这段 Snowflake SQL，让它跑得更快。
say.note: Claude 会分析并返回优化后的 SQL。

say.text: 这个查询为什么慢？怎么改进？
say.note: Claude 会检查性能反模式并给出优化建议。

howto.what_en: When you provide a Snowflake SQL query text, Claude analyzes and returns an optimized version that produces identical results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you paste a SQL query and ask to optimize, tune, or improve it, or when mentioning 'slow query', 'make faster', 'optimize SQL', or 'query tuning'.

say_en.text: Optimize this Snowflake SQL to run faster.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and return optimized SQL.

say_en.text: Why is this query slow? How to improve?
say_en.note: Claude checks for performance anti-patterns and suggests improvements.
